articles.title_en: Russia’s post-election utility hikes push annual inflation above the central bank’s 2026 forecast range
articles.lead_en: Weekly inflation in Russia rose to 0.96% in the week of September 29 to October 5, while annual inflation reached 7.1%, according to Rosstat, Russia’s statistics agency.

articles.title_en: Russia to double spending on internet traffic blocking and filtering
